"""design_E0E0: 퇴원 시점(tp) 코호트·결과·특성 테이블 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = ROOT / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.loads((ROOT / "design_E0E0.json").read_text())

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

a = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left").sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"])
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]

# outcome: 다음 입원의 admit_time 이 (tp, tp+30d] 안
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) & (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = a["admit_time"].max()
a["followup_days"] = (data_end - a["tp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400

# cohort
c = a[(a["age"] >= 18) & (a["discharge_status"] != "died")].copy()

# features — 진단은 해당 입원(index admission)의 코드만 사용
dx3 = dx.assign(c3=dx["icd_code"].str[:3])
c["dx_ckd"] = c["admission_id"].isin(dx3.loc[dx3.c3 == "N18", "admission_id"]).astype(int)
c["dx_chf"] = c["admission_id"].isin(dx3.loc[dx3.c3 == "I50", "admission_id"]).astype(int)
c["n_dx"] = c["admission_id"].map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
c["los_h"] = (c["discharge_time"] - c["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # 같은 환자의 이전 입원 수 (이 코호트 전 입원 포함 위해 a 기준으로 재계산)
c["n_prior_adm"] = c["admission_id"].map(a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount().set_axis(a["admission_id"]))

def window_labs(test):
    m = labs[labs["test"] == test].merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    return m[(m["report_time"] >= m["admit_time"]) & (m["report_time"] <= m["tp"])]

h = window_labs("hemoglobin")
c["hgb_min"] = c["admission_id"].map(h.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())
cr = window_labs("creatinine").sort_values("report_time")
c["cr_last"] = c["admission_id"].map(cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())

od = orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"].merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
od = od[(od["order_time"] >= od["admit_time"]) & (od["order_time"] <= od["tp"])]
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c["admission_id"].isin(od["admission_id"]).astype(int)

# 분할 그룹 후보: family_id 가 없으면 patient_id 로 대체
c["group_id"] = c["family_id"].fillna(c["patient_id"])

feat = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "group_id", "tp", "followup_days"] + feat + ["readmit_30d"]
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "dataset_E0E0.csv", index=False)
print(c[cols].shape)
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/9b24b5bd07d5-t1/ws/prep_E0E0 && python3 build_dataset.py
